regime_context: China A-shares thematic detector shows Semiconductors and AI Compute as the top two eligible, durable, trending, uncrowded themes, with Pharma third but overcrowded. The absolute-trend gate did not reduce drawdown historically on this market (gate_helps=false), so all leans are experimental. Macro backdrop is AI/tech and geopolitics with high unscheduled surprises, adding noise. This note is HUMBLE: given the detector's limited edge and a 0/2 track record, conviction is systematically low.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics (challenger) vs Semiconductors: margin is razor-thin (0.013). If AI Compute's score overtakes Semis AND its durability_bar stays >0.60 for 3 consecutive days, that would be a confirmed leadership handoff. Kill: margin widens back to >0.10 favoring Semis.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: The theme leads momentum ranks with a persistent trend (hurst 'trend', durability 0.69) and no crowding. While cross-sectional momentum itself has no alpha, the trend-health signals suggest the theme is not inherently fragile. The lean is a conditional continuation bet on that persistence, provided macro surprises don't spike.
theses.dissent: A sharp policy reversal or AI capex disappointment could whipsaw the theme; the mean-reverting tape invalidates trend-following historically, and momentum rank has ~0 predictive power.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors drops out of top-3 rank AND durability_bar falls below 0.50 within 10 trading days.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Despite high rank (#3) and the strongest durability (0.93), the theme is flagged crowded (z=1.39). Detector's only validated edge is drawdown avoidance via sizing down overextended themes; the crowding flag is a size-down caution. Combined with the absence of any gate edge on this tape, reducing exposure is prudent.
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level drawdown-timing power; a durable, universally-held theme could keep trending on structural healthcare demand. The underweight could lag if pharma re-accelerates.

falsifier.text: Crowding z-score falls below 0.5 while the theme remains top-3 eligible within 10 days.

theses.subject: Consumer Electronics
theses.thesis: Eligible and trending but participation is narrow (breadth 0.267) and durability is only 0.57, making the trend fragile. In a market where the trend gate historically fails to cut drawdown, low-breadth trending themes often whipsaw. Leaning underweight reduces exposure to that fragility.
theses.dissent: The theme could ride tech spillover flows and a short-covering pop; narrow breadth sometimes coincides with early-stage re-acceleration, not decay.

falsifier.text: Breadth rises above 0.50 AND durability_bar climbs above 0.65 within 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
